items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: I’d say well I like Oscar Peterson and Erroll Garner, Erroll was my favorite.

ctx.x: Did you listen to like Bud Powell?

Oh sure. I mean in fact when they’d ask me questions, guys come to review the bands that I was with, they’d ask the guys individually, who’s your favorite piano player, and I’d say well I like Oscar Peterson and Erroll Garner, Erroll was my favorite. Because he was a friend of mine. He used to send me Christmas cards. And one day my son found a Christmas card in the drawer. He said, “hey Dad.” I said, “what?” “Erroll Garner?” I said, “what?” He says, “he sent you a Christmas card?” I said, “yeah I get one every…
Wow, you’re legitimate all of a sudden.
